subs.name: 硫（煤与石油中的硫分）
subs.nameEn: Sulfur (the fraction in coal and oil)
subs.note: 动力煤含硫可达百分之几，燃烧先进入烟气。
subs.noteEn: Steam coal can carry several percent sulfur, which leaves in the flue gas.

subs.name: 氧气（空气）
subs.note: 燃烧与后续氧化都靠它。
subs.noteEn: Drives both the burning and the later oxidation.

subs.name: 二氧化硫
subs.note: 直接刺激呼吸道，也是酸雨的起始物。
subs.noteEn: Irritates airways and starts the acid-rain chain.

subs.name: 三氧化硫
subs.note: 在大气中由 SO₂ 缓慢氧化而来，飘尘起催化作用。
subs.noteEn: Formed slowly from SO₂ in air, catalyzed on dust particles.

subs.name: 水（云霦、雨水）
subs.note: SO₃ 极易与之结合。
subs.noteEn: SO₃ combines with it eagerly.

subs.name: 硫酸
subs.note: 硫酸型酸雨的主体，中国以它为主。
subs.noteEn: The heart of sulfate-type acid rain, dominant in China.

subs.name: 石灰石（脱硫浆液）
subs.note: 磨成浆液喷入吸收塔，来自主产石膏的钙源。
subs.noteEn: Ground to slurry in the absorber; the calcium for by-product gypsum.

subs.name: 硫酸钙（石膏）
subs.note: 脱硫副产物，回用作水泥缓凝剂与建材。
subs.noteEn: The by-product, sold on as a cement retarder and board material.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 碳酸盐分解带出，不增加脱硫的碳成本则不计。
subs.noteEn: Released by the carbonate; a small carbon cost of the route.

term: 酸雨与石灰石-石膏法脱硫
oneLiner: 煤中硫烧成 SO₂，在大气里氧化成硫酸随雨落下；用石灰石浆液在塔里把它固定成石膏。
oneLinerEn: Coal sulfur burns to SO₂, oxidizes in air to sulfuric acid and falls as rain; limestone slurry fixes it as gypsum inside the absorber.
detail: 正常雨水溶了 CO₂，pH 本底约 5.6，所以酸雨的定义是 pH 低于 5.6 的降水；pH 是对数尺度，每降 1 个单位，氢离子浓度就增为十倍。燃煤与石油中的硫分先烧成 SO₂，在大气中被缓慢氧化成 SO₃ 并与水结合成硫酸，硝酸型则来自汽车与高温燃烧的 NOx 经光化学氧化成硝酸；中国以硫酸型为主，且硫与氮的沉降既有随雨雪落下的湿沉降，也有直接吸附在地表与叶面的干沉降。危害包括湖泊酸化、土壤养分淋失与有毒的 Al³⁺ 被溶出毒害鱼鳃、森林退化，以及腐蚀石灰石与大理石建筑——CaCO₃ 遇酸生成可溶盐被雨水冲走，外表的“石壳”就是这样脱落的，金属桥梁与铁轨也加速锈蚀。治理主战场是烟气脱硫：把石灰石浆液喷入吸收塔与 SO₂ 反应，再鼓风氧化成石膏，湿法脱硫效率可达九成以上，石膏回用作水泥缓凝剂；配合煤改气、关停小机组与机动车尾气控氮，酸雨区面积已从上世纪九十年代的高位大幅收窄。
detailEn: Clean rain already holds dissolved CO₂ and sits near pH 5.6, so 'acid rain' means anything below that; because pH is logarithmic, every one-unit drop multiplies the hydrogen-ion concentration tenfold. Sulfur in coal and oil burns to SO₂, which oxidizes slowly in air to SO₃ and hydrates to sulfuric acid, while the nitric type comes from the NOx of vehicles and high-temperature combustion, photo-oxidized to nitric acid; sulfate-type deposition has dominated China, and it reaches the ground both wet (in rain and snow) and dry (adsorbed straight onto soil and leaves). Damage runs to acidified lakes, leached soils, toxic Al³⁺ mobilised that gills fish, dying forest, and stone: acid converts CaCO₃ into soluble salts that rain washes away, which is why building surfaces slough off, while bridges and rails corrode faster. The main control is flue-gas desulfurization — limestone slurry sprayed into an absorber reacts with the SO₂, is blown with air to gypsum, and removes better than ninety percent of the sulfur, the gypsum sold on to cement plants; alongside fuel-to-gas switching, closure of small boilers and engine-NOx limits, the acid-rain region has shrunk far from its 1990s peak.

subs.name: 一氧化碳
subs.note: 混合气过浓、燃烧不充分的产物，与血红蛋白结合力强。
subs.noteEn: From rich, incomplete combustion; binds hemoglobin tightly.

subs.name: 一氧化氮
subs.note: 气缸高温下氮气被固定而来，排入空气后继续氧化成 NO₂。
subs.noteEn: Nitrogen fixed at cylinder heat; it oxidizes on to NO₂ in air.

subs.name: 二氧化氮
subs.note: 红棕色、刺激性，也是光化学烟雾的引发物。
subs.noteEn: Red-brown and pungent; also the trigger of photochemical smog.

subs.name: 丙烯（未燃烃代表）
subs.note: 代表未烧完的燃油与润滑油成分。
subs.noteEn: Stands for unburned fuel and oil carry-over.

subs.name: 氧气（过量空气）
subs.note: 氧化 CO 与烃的氧化剂，含量由空燃比决定。
subs.noteEn: The oxidizer for CO and HC, set by the air-fuel ratio.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 氧化的终点：无毒但它是温室气体。
subs.noteEn: The oxidation end point: harmless, yet a greenhouse gas.

subs.name: 氮气
subs.note: NOx 被还原后的安全归宿。
subs.noteEn: Where NOx ends up once reduced.

subs.name: 水（蒸气）
subs.note: 烃氧化的另一产物。
subs.noteEn: The other product of burning hydrocarbons.

oneLiner: 铂铑把 CO 与 NOx 分别氧化、还原成 CO₂ 与 N₂，前提是空燃比守在理论值附近。
oneLinerEn: Platinum and rhodium oxidize CO and reduce NOx to CO₂ and N₂ — but only if the air-fuel ratio holds near stoichiometry.
detail: 汽油机尾气有三类污染物：缺氧燃烧生成的 CO、没烧完的碳氢化合物 HC，以及气缸高温下把氮气固定下来的 NOx。三效催化剂用铂、钯把 CO 与 HC 氧化，用铑把 NOx 还原成 N₂，而三件事同时做好的窗口很窄——空燃比必须守在理论值（汽油约 14.7∶1，即过量空气系数 λ≈1）附近，所以必须用氧传感器闭环控制；为缓冲 λ 的微小波动，涂层里还掺入铈的储氧材料，贫时供氧、富时吸氧。铅会使催化剂中毒，因此上了三元催化就必须用无铅汽油，硫、磷、锌同样会覆盖活性位、让它逐渐老化，长期高温更会烧结而永久失活。冷启动时催化剂未达起燃温度（约 200~300 ℃），此时净化效率最低，也是排放考核要测冷启动工况的原因。柴油车在富氧环境里三效无从施展，改用选择性催化还原，喷射车用尿素水溶液把 NOx 还原为 N₂。
detailEn: A petrol engine emits three problems: CO from oxygen-starved burning, unburned hydrocarbons, and NOx fixed from intake nitrogen at cylinder heat. The three-way catalyst oxidizes CO and HC over platinum and palladium and reduces NOx to N₂ over rhodium — but the window where all three work at once is narrow, so the air-fuel ratio must be held at stoichiometry (about 14.7:1 for petrol, λ≈1) under closed-loop control from an oxygen sensor, with a cerium oxygen-storage component built into the washcoat to give up oxygen when lean and absorb it when rich. Lead poisons the catalyst, which is why three-way cats demanded unleaded fuel, and sulfur, phosphorus and zinc likewise coat the active sites and age it gradually, while prolonged high heat sinters the surface and kills it outright. Until the brick reaches its light-off temperature, roughly 200–300 °C, purification barely works — the reason test cycles include a cold start. Diesel engines run lean, where the three-way scheme cannot work, so they switch to selective catalytic reduction, injecting aqueous urea to reduce NOx to N₂.

subs.name: 铁盐（氯化铁）
subs.note: 化学除磷的药剂，铝盐与石灰也可。
subs.noteEn: The dosed reagent; salts of aluminum or lime work too.

subs.name: 磷酸根
subs.note: 淡水富营养化通常由磷限量，来自洗涤剂与化肥。
subs.noteEn: In fresh water phosphorus is usually the limiting nutrient, from detergents and fertilizer.

subs.name: 磷酸铁沉淀
subs.note: 把磷固定进污泥，随剩余污泥排出系统。
subs.noteEn: Locks the phosphorus into sludge that leaves the plant.

subs.name: 铵根（氨氮）
subs.note: 尿液、化肥与养殖尾水的主要氮形态，本身对鱼有毒。
subs.noteEn: The main nitrogen form in waste; itself toxic to fish.

subs.name: 溶解氧
subs.note: 硝化菌需要好氧；藻类夜间与死亡分解时把它耗光。
subs.noteEn: Nitriers need it; algae and decaying biomass consume it overnight.

subs.name: 硝酸根
subs.note: 硝化产物，易随水迁移、不易沉淀。
subs.noteEn: The nitrification product: mobile and hard to precipitate.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 两个生物过程的共同产物或介质。
subs.noteEn: Product and medium of both biological steps.

subs.name: 氢离子（硝化产酸）
subs.note: 硝化耗碱度，碱度不足时 pH 下降会抑制菌。
subs.noteEn: Nitrification eats up alkalinity; a pH crash stalls the bacteria.

subs.name: 甲醇（外碳源）
subs.note: 进水碳源不足时投加，作反硝化的电子供体。
subs.noteEn: Dosed when the inflow is carbon-poor; it feeds the denitrifiers.

subs.name: 氮气
subs.note: 脱氮的终点：氮从水里回到空气。
subs.noteEn: The goal — nitrogen leaves the water for the air.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 甲醇被氧化后的产物。
subs.noteEn: What the methanol ends up as.

subs.name: 氢氧根（反硝化产碱）
subs.note: 反硝化回收约一半碱度，两段搭配才能自衡。
subs.noteEn: Denitrification returns about half the alkalinity; the two stages balance.

term: 水体富营养化与脱氮除磷
oneLiner: 铁盐把磷沉淀进污泥，先好氧硝化、再缺氧反硝化把硝态氮还原成氮气跑掉。
oneLinerEn: Precipitate phosphorus with iron salt; then nitrate aerobically and denitrify anoxically so the nitrogen escapes as gas.
detail: 氮磷本是养分，过量进水体就让藻类疯长。淡水通常由磷限量、海域多由氮限量；判富营养化程度看总磷总氮、叶绿素 a 与透明度。藻类白天产氧，夜间与死亡分解时却大量耗氧——分解的生化需氧量把溶解氧抽干，骤致鱼群窒息、底泥厌氧释磷并发臭：湖泊上叫水华，海里叫赤潮，蓝藻水华还会释放微囊藻毒素危害饮水安全。更棘手的是湖泊有清水态与浊水态两个稳态，磷一旦在底泥里累积就算截断外源也极易复发，治理因此须内外源并重。工程上两条线并进：化学除磷用铁盐、铝盐或石灰把磷酸根沉淀掉；生物脱氮先好氧硝化把铵氮变成硝态氮，再在缺氧池里投碳源让反硝化菌把 NO₃⁻ 还原成 N₂——氮就此从水里“跑”进空气。源头一侧则是限磷洗涤剂（三聚磷酸钠已受限）、化肥流失管控与养殖尾水处理，辅以清淤、曝气与人工湿地修复。
detailEn: Nitrogen and phosphorus are nutrients until they arrive in excess, and then algae bloom. Fresh water is usually phosphorus-limited, coastal water often nitrogen-limited, and the degree of enrichment is read from total nitrogen and phosphorus, chlorophyll a and water clarity. Algae make oxygen by day but consume it at night and as they decay — the biochemical oxygen demand of that rot drains the dissolved oxygen, fish suffocate, bottom sediment releases its phosphorus anaerobically and the water smells; on a lake it is a bloom, at sea a red tide, and cyanobacterial blooms add microcystins that threaten drinking water. Worse, a lake has two stable states, clear and turbid: once phosphorus has built up in the sediment it keeps recycling even after the outside supply is cut, so restoration must attack both internal and external loading. Treatment runs on two tracks: chemical removal precipitates phosphate with iron or aluminum salts, or with lime; biological removal nitrifies ammonium to nitrate under aeration, then denitrifies it to N₂ in an anoxic tank fed with carbon — the nitrogen leaves the water for the air. Upstream, the levers are low-phosphorus detergents (sodium tripolyphosphate is now restricted), fertilizer runoff control and cleanup of aquaculture effluent, backed by dredging, aeration and constructed wetlands.

subs.name: 铝离子（明矾溶出）
subs.note: 明矾 KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O 溶于水解离出来。
subs.noteEn: Released when alum dissolves.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 既是溶剂也是反应物。
subs.noteEn: Solvent and reactant at once.

subs.name: 氢氧化铝胶体
subs.note: 不是沉淀而是胶体，靠表面积吸附悬浮物。
subs.noteEn: A colloid, not a precipitate; its surface sweeps up suspended matter.

subs.name: 氢离子
subs.note: 水解产酸，原水碱度低时 pH 会下降。
subs.noteEn: Hydrolysis acidifies; low-alkalinity raw water will drop in pH.

subs.name: 氯气（液氯）
subs.note: 经典消毒剂，便宜且能持续抑菌。
subs.noteEn: The classic disinfectant: cheap and long-lasting.

subs.name: 盐酸
subs.note: 氯气溶于水的另一半产物，量极微。
subs.noteEn: The other half of chlorine in water, present in traces.

subs.name: 次氯酸
subs.note: 不带电荷、易穿透细胞壁，真正起杀菌作用的形态。
subs.noteEn: Uncharged, so it crosses cell walls — this is the actual killer.

subs.name: 臭氧
subs.note: 氧化能力更强且无副产氯，但水中存不住。
subs.noteEn: A stronger oxidizer with no chlorinated by-products, but it will not persist.

subs.name: 氧气
subs.note: 臭氧分解后的唯一残留。
subs.noteEn: All that ozone leaves behind.

oneLiner: 明矾水解生成胶体吸附杂质，氯或臭氧用强氧化杀死病原微生物。
oneLinerEn: Alum hydrolyzes to a scavenging colloid; chlorine or ozone kill pathogens by oxidation.
detail: 常规水厂的五步是絮凝、沉淀、过滤、吸附、消毒。明矾溶出 Al³⁺，水解生成的 Al(OH)₃ 是胶体，把悬浮颗粒与部分色度裹挟沉降。消毒靠强氧化且要看接触时间与浓度的乘积：液氯溶于水生成的 HClO 不带电荷、易穿透细胞壁，杀菌可靠且能在管网里留下余氯持续抑菌（出厂与管网末梢各有最低浓度要求）；但氯与原水里的有机物会生成三卤甲烷、卤乙酸等消毒副产物，因此不少水厂改用 ClO₂ 或臭氧——臭氧氧化能力更强、分解后只剩氧气，还能把难降解有机物预氧化，缺点是没有持续抑菌能力，往往需在后段补少量氯，深度处理常用臭氧配生物活性炭。紫外线只灭活、不投药也无余氯。家用活性炭主要吸附异味与有机物，去不掉重金属离子与多数无机盐；烧沸能除去暂时硬度（碳酸氢钙受热分解结垢），却不能去除所有污染。
detailEn: A conventional plant runs five steps: coagulation, sedimentation, filtration, adsorption, disinfection. Alum releases Al³⁺, whose hydrolysis product Al(OH)₃ is a colloid that sweeps suspended particles and color out of suspension. Disinfection is oxidation and is judged by a dose–time contact product: chlorine dissolved in water gives HClO, uncharged so it penetrates cell walls, reliable and — usefully — leaving a chlorine residual that keeps the pipework clean, with minimum values required both at the plant and at the far end of the network. But chlorine plus natural organic matter makes chlorinated by-products such as trihalomethanes and haloacetic acids, so many plants dose chlorine dioxide or ozone instead; ozone oxidizes harder, decays to oxygen alone and pre-oxidizes stubborn organics, but leaves nothing behind, so a small chlorine top-up is still needed, and advanced treatment often pairs ozone with biological activated carbon. UV only inactivates — no chemical, no residual. Household activated carbon mainly takes out taste and organics; it does not remove heavy-metal ions or most dissolved salts, and boiling only strips temporary hardness (calcium bicarbonate decomposes and scales), not every contaminant.

subs.name: 重铬酸根（六价铬）
subs.note: 电镀、制革、颜料废水里的形态，氧化性强、致癌。
subs.noteEn: Form found in plating, tanning and pigment effluent; strong oxidizer, carcinogenic.

subs.name: 亚硫酸钠（还原剂）
subs.note: 酸性条件下把 Cr(VI) 还原为 Cr(III)，也可用硫酸亚铁。
subs.noteEn: Reduces Cr(VI) in acid; ferrous sulfate works as well.

subs.name: 氢离子（调 pH≈2~3）
subs.note: 酸性是还原反应的前提，常用硫酸调。
subs.noteEn: Acidity is required for the reduction; dosed with sulfuric acid.

subs.name: 铬离子（三价）
subs.note: 毒性远低于六价，且能形成难溶氢氧化物。
subs.noteEn: Far less toxic and readily precipitated as the hydroxide.

subs.name: 硫酸根
subs.note: 亚硫酸根被氧化的产物，留在水中。
subs.noteEn: What the sulfite becomes; remains dissolved.

subs.name: 氢氧根（加石灰）
subs.note: 调至 pH 8~9 使铬完全沉淀。
subs.noteEn: Raised to pH 8–9 to finish the precipitation.

subs.name: 氢氧化铬沉淀
subs.note: 压滤除去，滤饼属危险废物。
subs.noteEn: Filter-pressed out; the cake is hazardous waste.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 还原反应的产物，也作稀释介质。
subs.noteEn: Product of the reduction and the carrier of the whole process.

term: 含铬废水的还原沉淀处理
oneLiner: 酸性下用亚硫酸钠把六价铬还原为三价，再加石灰沉淀成 Cr(OH)₃ 滤除。
oneLinerEn: Reduce Cr(VI) to Cr(III) with sulfite in acid, then precipitate Cr(OH)₃ with lime and filter it out.
detail: 电镀与制革废水里最常见的是六价铬。它以 Cr₂O₇²⁻（酸性）或 CrO₄²⁻（碱性）存在，氧化性强、易穿透生物膜，是明确的致癌物；而三价铬溶解度低、毒性小得多。所以处理思路是“先还原、后沉淀”：酸性下投加亚硫酸钠、焦亚硫酸钠或硫酸亚铁把 Cr(VI) 还原为 Cr³⁺，再加石灰调至弱碱性生成 Cr(OH)₃ 沉淀，压滤分离；这里 pH 是关键——Cr(OH)₃ 有两性，碱加过量又会溶解成 CrO₂⁻ 重新进入溶液，故须控在合适的弱碱区间。达标口径极严（总铬与六价铬各有以毫克每升计的排放限值），滤饼属含铬危险废物、不能随意填埋，清水需复检达标后排放。另一条路线是离子交换吸附或电解法回收，把铬回用于镀液，铁氧体法则让铬与其他重金属共沉淀为较稳定的磁性固体，既省原料又减泥量。
detailEn: Hexavalent chromium is the common pollutant of electroplating and tanning wastewater. It exists as Cr₂O₇²⁻ in acid and CrO₄²⁻ in alkali: a strong oxidizer that crosses cell membranes readily and a confirmed carcinogen, whereas Cr(III) is far less toxic and barely soluble. Hence the two-stage logic — reduce first, then precipitate: dose sulfite, metabisulfite or ferrous sulfate in acid to bring Cr(VI) down to Cr³⁺, then add lime to make the solution mildly alkaline so Cr(OH)₃ falls out and can be filter-pressed. pH is the crux here: Cr(OH)₃ is amphoteric, so overdosing alkali redissolves it as CrO₂⁻ and returns it to solution, and the value must stay in a narrow mildly-alkaline window. Discharge limits on total and hexavalent chromium are strict (measured in milligrams per litre), the filter cake is hazardous chromous waste that cannot simply be landfilled, and the clarified water is re-tested before it leaves. The alternative route recovers chromium by ion exchange or electrolysis and returns it to the plating bath, while a ferrite process co-precipitates chromium with other heavy metals into a stable magnetic solid, saving both chemical and sludge.

subs.name: 石灰石粉（炉内喷钙）
subs.note: 价格低廉，分解后的 CaO 同时吸硫吸氯。
subs.noteEn: Cheap; the CaO it gives up takes up sulfur and chlorine alike.

subs.name: 氯化氢（烟气中的酸）
subs.note: 来自 PVC 等含氯垃圾，是焚烧最主要的酸性气体。
subs.noteEn: From PVC and other chlorinated waste; the chief acid in municipal incineration.

subs.name: 氯化钙
subs.note: 脱酸生成的中性盐，随飞灰处理。
subs.noteEn: The neutral salt formed; handled with the fly ash.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 中和反应的产物。
subs.noteEn: Product of the neutralization.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 碳酸盐分解带出的气体。
subs.noteEn: Released when the carbonate decomposes.

subs.name: 熟石灰（半干法）
subs.note: 喷成细雾，一边吸水一边中和酸性气体。
subs.noteEn: Atomized so it dries the gas while neutralizing it.

subs.name: 氧化铜（含铜废料）
subs.note: 废铜与电镀污泥灼烧后的形态。
subs.noteEn: What scrap copper and plating sludge leave behind after roasting.

subs.name: 稀硫酸（浸出剂）
subs.note: 把铜转入溶液，以便后续电积。
subs.noteEn: Moves copper into solution for electrowinning.

subs.name: 硫酸铜溶液
subs.note: 电解得阴极铜；与湿法炼铜同源。
subs.noteEn: Electrolyzed to cathode copper — the same chemistry as heap leaching.

oneLiner: 850 ℃ 以上停留 2 秒分解二噁英，石灰吸收 HCl 与 SO₂，飞灰按危险废物处理。
oneLinerEn: Hold the flame above 850 °C for two seconds to crack dioxins, scrub the acid gases with lime, and treat fly ash as hazardous waste.
detail: 焚烧是减量最彻底的末端手段，但要管住两件事。一是二噁英：炉温需保持在 850 ℃ 以上、烟气停留不少于 2 秒才能把已生成的分解掉；而烟气降温时又在 250~400 ℃ 区间“从头合成”，所以出口必须急冷、快速穿过这段温度。二是酸性气体与飞灰：HCl 与 SO₂ 用石灰石喷射或半干法石灰浆吸收，飞灰富集重金属与二噁英，属危险废物，须螯合稳定化后进安全填埋场；炉渣则多用作路基材料。回收侧的账很清楚：再生铝的能耗只有原铝的约 5%，所以分类回收的价值首先在于能源与矿产，而不是“变废为金”——那一步只在电子废弃物上才成立，且必须集中处理。
detailEn: Incineration is the most thorough way to shrink a waste stream, provided two things are controlled. First, dioxins: the combustion chamber must stay above 850 °C with the gas resident at least two seconds to destroy what has formed, yet as the flue gas cools it re-synthesizes dioxins de novo between 250 and 400 °C, so the outlet is quench-cooled straight through that window. Second, acid gas and fly ash: HCl and SO₂ are taken up by injected limestone or a semidry lime slurry, while the fly ash concentrates heavy metals and dioxins, is classified hazardous, and must be chelate-stabilized before it can go to a secure landfill; the bottom ash, by contrast, is largely usable as road base. The recovery arithmetic is blunt: recycled aluminum costs about five percent of the energy of primary metal, so the value of sorting is energy and ore first, not turning trash into gold — that last trick only pays on electronic waste, and only in centralized hands.

subs.name: 纯碱溶液（吸收剂）
subs.note: 碳酸钠循环法用廉价天然碱代替有机胺，没有胺降解问题。
subs.noteEn: The soda cycle uses cheap trona instead of an amine, so nothing degrades.

subs.name: 二氧化碳（烟气中的）
subs.note: 燃煤烟气里只占 12~15%，要先被富集才谈得上利用。
subs.noteEn: Only 12–15% of coal flue gas, so it must be concentrated before it can be used.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 参与吸收，也是转化反应的副产物。
subs.noteEn: Joins the absorption and comes back out of the conversion.

subs.name: 碳酸氢钠（负载产物）
subs.note: CO₂ 被“装”进溶液的形式，受热即可倒出来。
subs.noteEn: How the CO₂ is carried in solution — heat releases it again.

subs.name: 高纯二氧化碳（再生气）
subs.note: 解吸后近乎纯净，可直接封存或作碳源。
subs.noteEn: Nearly pure after desorption, ready for storage or as a feedstock.

subs.name: 氢气（还原剂）
subs.note: 必须来自电解水的绿电，否则整条路线是亏碳的。
subs.noteEn: Must come from water electrolysis on surplus power, or the carbon balance goes negative.

subs.name: 甲醇
subs.note: 常温液体，可直接进现有燃料与化工体系。
subs.noteEn: A liquid at ambient conditions, so it slots into existing fuel and chemical chains.

subs.name: 氨
subs.note: 与 CO₂ 合成尿素，是目前最大宗的固定用途。
subs.noteEn: Combined with CO₂ into urea, still the largest single use.

subs.name: 尿素
subs.note: 每生产 1 t 尿素约消耗 0.73 t CO₂。
subs.noteEn: About 0.73 t of CO₂ per tonne of urea.

term: 二氧化碳的捕集与资源化
oneLiner: 纯碱溶液把 CO₂ 变成碳酸氢钠，受热再放回一股近纯气；剩下的问题是给它找一个值得的去处。
oneLinerEn: Soda ash solution loads CO₂ as bicarbonate and gives it back near-pure on heating; the hard part is finding somewhere worth putting it.
detail: 捕集分三步账。第一是分离：烟气中 CO₂ 只有 12~15%，浓度低、压力大，所以任何捕集都要付出可观的能量与成本。主流是 30% 单乙醇胺溶液在约 60 ℃ 化学吸收、约 120 ℃ 解吸，缺点是胺会降解、能耗偏高；碳酸钠循环法用天然碱作吸收剂，低温吸收成碳酸氢钠、加热又放回近纯 CO₂，代价是设备体积与碱耗。第二是封存或转化：近纯 CO₂ 可以注入油田驱油、矿化成碳酸盐，或深部咸水层封存。第三是利用：加氢制甲醇、与氨合成尿素、与甲烷干重整制合成气。前两条早已工业化，第三条里“绿氢 + 捕集 CO₂ 制甲醇”最被看好，国内已有千吨级示范装置——但整条路线的碳账完全取决于氢气是否来自可再生能源电力，否则制氢排出的 CO₂ 比固定掉的还多。
detailEn: Keep the accounting in three parts. First, separation: flue gas carries only 12–15% CO₂ at low partial pressure, so capture always costs real energy and money. The mainstream route is 30% monoethanolamine, absorbing near 60 °C and releasing near 120 °C, limited by amine degradation and reboiler duty; the soda cycle uses trona instead, loading CO₂ into bicarbonate at mild temperature and cracking it back out as a near-pure stream, paying instead in vessel size and alkali loss. Second, storage: the concentrated gas can be injected into depleted oil reservoirs for enhanced recovery, mineralized as carbonates, or locked in deep saline aquifers. Third, use: hydrogenation to methanol, synthesis with ammonia to urea, dry reforming with methane to syngas. The first two are long industrialized; of the third, green hydrogen plus captured CO₂ to methanol looks strongest, and demonstration plants at thousand-tonne scale already run in China — but the whole carbon ledger hinges on whether that hydrogen came from renewable power, since otherwise the hydrogen production emits more CO₂ than the process fixes.
